about.headline: We Are a Taiwan Company
about.subtitle: With 3 verticals: Machinery, Parts and Technology.
about.para1: We have been supplying Machines to the Global markets and many of our Clients use us to develop the best process, build the Machines, prove the process and then ship the Lines to their Clients in low cost markets like India, Mexico, Turkey, Brazil.
about.para2: We also have over 20 Part manufacturing Partners who produce high volume, world class Stampings, Forgings, Castings, Machined Parts, Sintered / MIM Parts, Oil Seals, Couplings, Plastic Moulded parts, Bearings and Fasteners etc., for the global markets.
about.para3: We also supply standard / custom Geared / Un-Geared BLDC Motors, Touch Panels, Panel PC's, SBC's, TFT Display and a wide range of passive components, Relays, Connectors and Switchgear.
about.para5: We specialize in complex, precision high volume Parts. We don't compete with China prices / quality but offer our Clients a higher level of quality, integrity, reliability and IP protection; at a cost-effective price.
about.para6: We welcome your RFQ and assure you of our prompt attention, competitive prices and a long Partnership.
